veranderings.voor: kook en stap saam skool toe
veranderings.na: kook en stap saam met hulle skool toe
veranderings.rede: 'saam' has no stated partner; 'met hulle' makes clear the grandparent walks with the children.

veranderings.voor: Respek is nie net wat 'n kind vir 'n grootmens gee nie
veranderings.na: Respek is nie net iets wat 'n kind aan 'n grootmens gee nie
veranderings.rede: Standard Afrikaans gives something 'aan' someone, and 'iets wat' reads more naturally than a bare 'wat'.

veranderings.voor: om dit te vertel vir 'n volwassene wat hy vertrou
veranderings.na: om dit vir 'n volwassene wat hy vertrou, te vertel
veranderings.rede: In standard Afrikaans the infinitive 'te vertel' goes at the end of the clause; the protected verb is kept.

veranderings.na: Hy hou aan om dit te vertel totdat
veranderings.rede: 'aanhou' takes 'om te' plus the infinitive; 'hou aan vertel' is ungrammatical.

veranderings.blok: Take vir seuns en take vir meisies
veranderings.voor: hang dan af van of dit
veranderings.na: hang dan daarvan af of dit
veranderings.rede: Before an 'of' clause Afrikaans uses the pronominal 'daarvan af', not 'af van of'.

veranderings.voor: Baie mense dink vandag nog net vrouens moet by 'n kleuterskool werk
veranderings.na: Baie mense dink vandag nog dat net vrouens by 'n kleuterskool moet werk
veranderings.rede: Adding 'dat' with verb-final order makes the reported thought clear, so 'nog net' is not misread as one phrase.

veranderings.voor: hang wasgoed op en die vrou oorkant
veranderings.na: hang wasgoed op, en die vrou oorkant
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

vlae.teks: Daardie gedrag vra nooit respek van 'n kind nie.
vlae.rede: This is unclear: it could mean the behaviour never earns a child's respect, or that respect never requires a child to accept it. Fixing it means guessing which was meant, so I have not changed it.

vlae.blok: Dieselfde regte vir seuns en meisies
vlae.teks: of tuis leer as die ouers dit laat registreer
vlae.rede: It is not clear what 'dit' refers to (the child, or the home learning). Making it clear would mean adding content about home-education registration, so I have not changed it.

vlae.blok: Dieselfde regte vir seuns en meisies
vlae.rede: 'ook' suggests discrimination came up earlier, but the study text never names or defines it before this point (it appears only in the glossary). This is for the writer to decide, not a language change.
